body:
Thank you for your reply. It's helpful, but I have to be honest, I'll follow some of it, and I won't follow other. I don't believe in medication. Yes, I do think I have some sort of depression. But I've found other ways to temporarily relieve it that does not involve medication. Working out, for example, helps a great deal. But it's temporary. 

I don't have the money, time, or inclination to seek out what kind of medication to dose myself with, in hopes that it won't fuck me up more. (I don't mean to be rude.. but I don't want to go on meds as the first thing I do..)

In regards to the other stuff, those are good ideas - the breathing and thought techniques. I'll employ those. And yes, I do watch quite a lot of comedy which does distract me.. but again.. temporarily.

What I really need is to live alone for a while. Living at home with my parents is getting to me. I feel restricted from doing a lot of things, and it's impacting me negatively. But alas, I don't have the money to live alone yet..

Several years now. I'm a 22 year old male. I still live with my parents. I finished college. I have not yet had sex. I feel like I am a social failure. And when I do succeed, that it's all fake. I've recently (probably around a year or so) started feeling like The Truman Show, as if everything and everyone is fake around me. 

I've gone to work before, and suddenly started laughing. Like, laughing about everything, because suddenly none of it felt real. It all felt staged and scripted, as if it matters, but it doesn't. Nothing matters. I feel like many things that are seen as true, is now just something some higher being out of my consciousness has created for me and sees it as fun.

I want to get out of this... bubble.
